rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Single-eyed Cyclops forging Zeus thunderbolt in underground iron foundry.

visual_requirements.description: Godlike human form with exactly one eye in middle of forehead, no lateral eye sockets.
Forges Zeus thunderbolt; metal sparks and contained lightning in artifact.

aura: Kekuatan melalui mata tunggal dan aksi menempa petir Zeus (steropes-c04, steropes-c08), cahaya dibatasi pada benda tempaan.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
Apron/tunic are editorial modest clothing. Thunderbolt lightning is restricted to artifact, not invented bodily power.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of STEROPES, the one-eyed Cyclops making Zeus's thunderbolt.
ANATOMY: ONE powerful godlike human head with exactly ONE LARGE EYE set centrally in the FOREHEAD [steropes-c04,c05], lower face continuous solid skin with NO second eyes or lateral eye hollows; TWO arms, TWO legs; rugged bearded male, opaque leather smith apron and opaque tunic covering torso/hips, not nude.
MOMENT: forcefully hammering a half-forged metal THUNDERBOLT onto a huge iron anvil, muscles straining, single forehead eye fixed sharply on the striking point and directed near the viewer.
POWER: thunderbolt-maker at work [steropes-c01,c08]; branching bright lightning confined to the jagged thunderbolt artifact on the anvil, orange metal sparks burst at hammer impact, no lightning from body or eye.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, central forehead eye and hammer dominate square, enormous smith shoulders fill frame, anvil in near foreground; no other Cyclopes or humans.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single incandescent forge behind anvil provides warm rim light, thunderbolt small white-hot accent; deep cave shadow, smoke and sparks.
SURFACE: soot-covered skin, cracked leather, hammered iron, rough cave walls.
SETTING: underground iron foundry in Sicilian cave [steropes-c03,c08].
MOOD: overwhelming craft and strength, dangerous active force.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; precisely one forehead eye and NO other eye sockets, no extra arms or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Exactly one central forehead eye, no lateral eyes or sockets. Two arms hammer/tongs, artifact thunderbolt on anvil, sparks only at impact. Opaque smith garments. Native and 200px inspected.
